settings.status: PRE-REGISTERED before walkthrough rendering or image comparisons
settings.walking_height_basis: ASSUMED conservative camera-operator envelope, not an architectural standard
settings.motion_basis: ASSUMED slow walkthrough camera operation; no published speed or yaw standard claimed

sample_difference.basis: ASSUMED image fidelity criterion, registered before measurements
sample_difference.metric: mean absolute RGB channel error in developed 8-bit PNG divided by 255, same camera, seed, exposure, white balance, full 1920x1080 frame
sample_difference.requirement: all three representative frames also pass unmodified render_qa

temporal_difference.basis: ASSUMED temporal noise criterion, registered before measurements
temporal_difference.metric: mean absolute RGB change between adjacent candidate frames on static opaque high-roughness surfaces reprojected using measured world position and first-hit position agreement within 0.03 m; reject disocclusion, four-pixel borders, depth edges, glass, emissive and unmatched pixels; RGB divided by 255; includes real view-dependent changes conservatively
temporal_difference.registration_revision: 2026-10-15 before any walkthrough image rendering or measurement: use actual reprojected candidate changes, avoiding an unnecessary 1024-sample reference for every final frame; threshold unchanged at 0.01
temporal_difference.coverage: every adjacent frame pair; insufficient valid static pixels refuses acceptance

settings.exposure_scope: all 720 path frames; one complete-clip source population and one upper-median meter lock; no still-view lock reuse
settings.final_gate: ~/archpipe/logs/render/finals.done must exist before final GPU work
